## Purpose

This document defines the mandatory AI disclosure paragraph required near the end of the HW01 report before appendices.

Goals:

* Declare AI use transparently
* Separate AI-assisted work from student-written work
* Reference the AI Audit Report
* Confirm prohibited artifacts were not AI-generated
* Reduce risk of false or incomplete disclosure

---

## Required Disclosure Pattern

Use this pattern and fill the brackets accurately:

```text
[Test cases / script / dataset / report section] was initially generated by [AI tool name]; I reviewed and modified [section X], added [edge cases Y, Z]; [section W] was written entirely by me. The detailed AI Audit Report is attached as Appendix A. I confirm I did not use AI to generate any artifact listed in the prohibited category below.
```

---

## HW01 Working Version

```text
Parts of [job-market research / software-defect analysis / physical-product test-case drafting / report organization] were initially supported by [AI tool name]. I reviewed and modified [specific sections], corrected [specific AI mistakes or AI-OBS IDs], and added [specific human-created edge cases, evidence, or analysis]. The [device photo, execution videos with my voice narration, job-posting screenshots with my account name, and prompt log timestamps] were produced by me and were not AI-generated. The detailed AI Audit Report is attached as Appendix A. I confirm I did not use AI to generate any artifact listed in the prohibited category.
```

---

## Prohibited Artifact Reminder

Do not claim AI created or modified these required evidence artifacts:

* Device photo with student ID card in the same frame
* Execution videos with student voice narration
* Job-posting screenshots showing login/account name
* Prompt log timestamps
* Any other anti-cheat evidence checked by the teaching team

## Final Notes

The disclosure must be accurate, not flattering. If AI helped with an artifact, disclose it and explain the human review.
